verses.sa: अग्निश्च पृथिवी च सन्नते ते मे सं नमतामदो वायुश्चान्तरिक्षं च सन्नते ते मे सं नमतामद आदित्यश्च द्यौश्च सन्नते ते मे सं नमतामद आपश्च वरुणश्च सन्नते ते मे सं नमतामदः। सप्त संसदो अष्टमी भूतसाधनी। सकामाँ२अध्वनस्कुरु संज्ञानमस्तु मेऽमुना॥
verses.tr: agniśca pṛthivī ca sannate te me saṃ namatāmado vāyuścāntarikṣaṃ ca sannate te me saṃ namatāmada ādityaśca dyauśca sannate te me saṃ namatāmada āpaśca varuṇaśca sannate te me saṃ namatāmadaḥ sapta saṃsado aṣṭamī bhūtasādhanī sakāmāṃ2adhvanaskuru saṃjñānamastu me'munā
verses.en: Agni and Prithivi, closely connected, may they bring low for me the boon I mention. Vayu and Firmament, closely connected, may they, etc. Closely connected Dyaus and the Aditya, may they, etc. Closely connected Varuna and Waters, may they, etc. Lord of the seven communities and her who forms all beings, eighth. Make our ways full of pleasantness: may So-and-So and I agree.

verses.sa: यथेमां वाचं कल्याणीमावदानि जनेभ्यः। ब्रह्मराजन्याभ्यां शूद्राय चार्याय च स्वाय चारणाय च। प्रियो देवानां दक्षिणायै दातुरिह भूयासमयं मे कामः समृध्यतामुप मादो नमतु॥
verses.tr: yathemāṃ vācaṃ kalyāṇīmāvadāni janebhyaḥ brahmarājanyābhyāṃ śūdrāya cāryāya ca svāya cāraṇāya ca priyo devānāṃ dakṣiṇāyai dāturiha bhūyāsamayaṃ me kāmaḥ samṛdhyatāmupa mādo namatu
verses.en: That I to all the people may address this salutary speech, To priest and nobleman, $Sudra and Arya, to one of our own kin and to the stranger. Dear may I be to Gods and guerdon-giver. Fulfilled be this my hope: be that my portion!

verses.sa: बृहस्पते अति यदर्यो अर्हाद् द्युमद्विभाति क्रतुमज्जनेषु। यद्दीदयच्छवस ऋतप्रजात तदस्मासु द्रविणं धेहि चित्रम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि बृहस्पतये त्वैष ते योनिर्बृहस्पतये त्वा॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate ati yadaryo arhād dyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu yaddīdayacchavasa ṛtaprajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram upayāmagṛhīto'si bṛhaspataye tvaiṣa te yonirbṛhaspataye tvā
verses.en: Give us, Brihaspati, that wondrous treasure, that which exceeds the merit of the foeman, Which shines among the folk effectual, splendid, that. Son of Law, which is with might refulgent. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Brihaspati. This is thy home. Thee for Brihaspati,

verses.sa: इन्द्र गोमन्निहा याहि पिबा सोमं शतक्रतो। विद्यद्भिर्ग्रावभिः सुतम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा गोमत एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा गोमते॥
verses.tr: indra gomannihā yāhi pibā somaṃ śatakrato vidyadbhirgrāvabhiḥ sutam upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā gomata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā gomate
verses.en: Come hither, Indra, rich in kine! Drink Soma, Lord of Hundred Powers, Effused by braying pressing-stones. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Indra, rich in kine. This is thy home. Thee for indra, rich in kine.

verses.sa: इन्द्रा याहि वृत्रहन्पिबा सोमं शतक्रतो। गोमद्भिर्ग्रावभिः सुतम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा गोमत एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा गोमते॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi vṛtrahanpibā somaṃ śatakrato gomadbhirgrāvabhiḥ sutam upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā gomata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā gomate
verses.en: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, come. Drink Soma, Lord of Hundred Powers, Expressed with stones whose wealth is kine. Taken upon a base art thou, etc., as in verse.

verses.sa: ऋतावानं वैश्वानरमृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पतिम्। अजस्रं घर्ममीमहे। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि वैश्वानराय त्वैष ते योनिर्वैश्वानराय त्वा॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvānaṃ vaiśvānaramṛtasya jyotiṣaspatim ajasraṃ gharmamīmahe upayāmagṛhīto'si vaiśvānarāya tvaiṣa te yonirvaiśvānarāya tvā
verses.en: Vaisvdnara the righteous One, the Lord of sacrifice and light. The heat that waste th not, we seek. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Vaisvanara. This is thy home: thee for Vaisvanara.

verses.sa: वैश्वानरस्य सुमतौ स्याम राजा हि कं भुवनानामभिश्रीः। इतो जातो विश्वमिदं वि चष्टे वैश्वानरो यतते सूर्येण। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि वैश्वानराय त्वैष ते योनिर्वैश्वानराय त्वा॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarasya sumatau syāma rājā hi kaṃ bhuvanānāmabhiśrīḥ ito jāto viśvamidaṃ vi caṣṭe vaiśvānaro yatate sūryeṇa upayāmagṛhīto'si vaiśvānarāya tvaiṣa te yonirvaiśvānarāya tvā
verses.en: Still in Vaisvanara's grace may we continue: yea, he is King Supreme o'er all things living. Sprung hence to life upon this All he looketh. Vaisvanaia hath rivalry with Surya. Taken upon a base art thou, etc., as in verse

verses.sa: वैश्वानरो न ऊतय आ प्र यातु परावतः। अग्निरुक्थेन वाहसा। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि वैश्वानराय त्वैष ते योनिर्वैश्वानराय त्वा॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaro na ūtaya ā pra yātu parāvataḥ agnirukthena vāhasā upayāmagṛhīto'si vaiśvānarāya tvaiṣa te yonirvaiśvānarāya tvā
verses.en: Hitherward come Vaisvanara to succour us from far away, Agni through laud that brings him near! Taken upon a base, etc, as in verse

verses.sa: अग्निरृषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः। तमीमहे महागयम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यग्नये त्वा वर्चस एष ते योनिरग्नये त्वा वर्चसे॥
verses.tr: agnirṛṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ tamīmahe mahāgayam upayāmagṛhīto'syagnaye tvā varcasa eṣa te yoniragnaye tvā varcase
verses.en: Agni is Pavamana, Sage, the Tribe-Priest; of the Races Fire: To him of mighty wealth we pray. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for lustre.. This is thy home. Thee for lustre.

verses.sa: महाँ२ इन्द्रो वज्रहस्तः षोडशी शर्म यच्छतु। हन्तु पाप्मानं योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि॥ उपयामगृहीतोऽसि महेन्द्राय त्वैष ते योनिर्महेन्द्राय त्वा॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ2 indro vajrahastaḥ ṣoḍaśī śarma yacchatu hantu pāpmānaṃ yo'smāndveṣṭi upayāmagṛhīto'si mahendrāya tvaiṣa te yonirmahendrāya tvā
verses.en: May mighty Indra, thunder-armed, may Shodas; protect us well, and slay the wicked man who hateth us. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Mahendra. This is thy home. Thee for Mahendra.

verses.sa: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः। अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे॥
verses.tr: taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣahaṃ vasormandānamandhasaḥ abhi vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava indraṃ gīrbhirnavāmahe
verses.en: As cows low to their calves in stalls so with our songs we glorify, This Indra, e'en your wondrous God who checks assault,,.who joys in the delicious juice.

verses.sa: यद्वाहिष्ठं तदग्नये बृहदर्च विभावसो। महिषीव त्वद्रयिस्त्वद्वाजा उदीरते॥
verses.tr: yadvāhiṣṭhaṃ tadagnaye bṛhadarca vibhāvaso mahiṣīva tvadrayistvadvājā udīrate
verses.en: Agni's is the most fetching song. Shine mightily, thou rich in light! I Like the Chief Consort of a King, riches and strength proceed from thee.

verses.sa: एह्यू षु ब्रवाणि तेऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः। एभिर्वर्धास इन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: ehyū ṣu bravāṇi te'gna itthetarā giraḥ ebhirvardhāsa indubhiḥ
verses.en: Come, here, O Agni, will I sing verily other songs to thee, And with these drops shalt thou grow strong.

verses.sa: ऋतवस्ते यज्ञं वि तन्वन्तु मासा रक्षन्तु ते हविः। संवत्सरस्ते यज्ञं दधातु नः प्रजां च परि पातु नः॥
verses.tr: ṛtavaste yajñaṃ vi tanvantu māsā rakṣantu te haviḥ saṃvatsaraste yajñaṃ dadhātu naḥ prajāṃ ca pari pātu naḥ
verses.en: The Seasons spread thy sacrifice! the Months protect thine offering! May the Year guard our sacrifice for thee and keep kt p our children safe.

verses.sa: उपह्वरे गिरीणां सङ्गमे च नदीनाम्। धिया विप्रो अजायत॥
verses.tr: upahvare girīṇāṃ saṅgame ca nadīnām dhiyā vipro ajāyata
verses.en: There where the mountains downward slope, there by the meeting of the streams The sage was manifest with song.

verses.sa: उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि सद्भूम्या ददे। उग्रं शर्म महि श्रवः॥
verses.tr: uccā te jātamandhaso divi sadbhūmyā dade ugraṃ śarma mahi śravaḥ
verses.en: High is thy juice's birth: though set in heaven, on earth it hath obtained Strong sheltering power and great renown.

verses.sa: स न इन्द्राय यज्यवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः। वरिवोवित्परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: sa na indrāya yajyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ varivovitpari srava
verses.en: Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra, meet for worship, flow For Varuna and the Marut host.

verses.sa: एना विश्वान्यर्य आ द्युम्नानि मानुषाणाम्। सिषासन्तो वनामहे॥
verses.tr: enā viśvānyarya ā dyumnāni mānuṣāṇām siṣāsanto vanāmahe
verses.en: Striving to win, with him we gain all wealth of the ungodly one, Yea, all the glories of mankind.

verses.sa: अनु वीरैरनु पुष्यास्म गोभिरन्वश्वैरनु सर्वेण पुष्टैः। अनु द्विपदाऽनु चतुष्पदा वयं देवा नो यज्ञमृतुथा नयन्तु॥
verses.tr: anu vīrairanu puṣyāsma gobhiranvaśvairanu sarveṇa puṣṭaiḥ anu dvipadā'nu catuṣpadā vayaṃ devā no yajñamṛtuthā nayantu
verses.en: May we be prosperous with brave sons, cattle, horses, each wirth of ours, and varied blessings. With quadrupeds, and with the men about us. May the Gods guide our sacrifice in season. >0

verses.sa: अग्ने पत्नीरिहा वह देवानामुशतीरुप। त्वष्टारं सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: agne patnīrihā vaha devānāmuśatīrupa tvaṣṭāraṃ somapītaye
verses.en: Agni, bring thou hither ward the yearning Consorts of the Gods, Bring Tvashtar to the Soma-draught.

verses.sa: अभि यज्ञं गृणीहि नो ग्नावो नेष्टः पिब ऋतुना। त्वं हि रत्नधा असि॥
verses.tr: abhi yajñaṃ gṛṇīhi no gnāvo neṣṭaḥ piba ṛtunā tvaṃ hi ratnadhā asi
verses.en: O Neshtar girt by Dames, accept our sacrifice: with Bitii drink, For thou art he who giveth wealth.

verses.sa: द्रविणोदाः पिपीषति जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत। नेष्ट्रादृतुभिरिष्यत॥
verses.tr: draviṇodāḥ pipīṣati juhota pra ca tiṣṭhata neṣṭrādṛtubhiriṣyata
verses.en: He with the Tlitug fain would drink, Wealth-giver, from the Nestar's's bowl. Begin, pay offerings: hasten ye.

verses.sa: तवायं सोमस्त्वमेह्यर्वाड् शश्वत्तमं सुमना अस्य पाहि। अस्मिन् यज्ञे बर्हिष्या निषद्या दधिष्वेमं जठर इन्दुमिन्द्र॥
verses.tr: tavāyaṃ somastvamehyarvāḍ śaśvattamaṃ sumanā asya pāhi asmin yajñe barhiṣyā niṣadyā dadhiṣvemaṃ jaṭhara indumindra
verses.en: Thine is this Soma: come thou near, approach it. Drink thou thereof, benevolent, and cease not. Sit on the sacred grass at this our worship, and take these drops into thy belly, Indra.

verses.sa: अमेव नः सुहवा आ हि गन्तन नि बर्हिषि सदतना रणिष्टन। अथा मन्दस्व जुजुषाणो अन्धसस्त्वष्टर्देवेभिर्जनिभिः सुमद्गणः॥
verses.tr: ameva naḥ suhavā ā hi gantana ni barhiṣi sadatanā raṇiṣṭana athā mandasva jujuṣāṇo andhasastvaṣṭardevebhirjanibhiḥ sumadgaṇaḥ
verses.en: Come unto us, ye swift to listen! as at ho, home, upon the sacred grass sit and enjoy yourselves. And, Tvashtar, well content be joyful in the juice with Gods and Goddesses in gladsome company.

verses.sa: स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया। इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः॥
verses.tr: svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasva soma dhārayā indrāya pātave sutaḥ

verses.sa: रक्षोहा विश्वचर्षणिरभि योनिमयोहते। द्रोणे सधस्थमासदत्॥
verses.tr: rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇirabhi yonimayohate droṇe sadhasthamāsadat
verses.en: In sweetest and most gladdening stream' flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, Pressed out for Indra, for his drink.
Fiend queller, Friend of all men, he hath in, the vat attained unto His place, his iron-fashioned home.
